simulation.seed_rule: For anchor index j and offset x: early seed=seedbase+j*1000+2*x; late seed=seedbase+j*1000+2*x+1.
simulation.raw_arrays_note: Anchors and count matrices were computed in-memory; this compact certificate stores procedure, worst count, and SHA-256 hashes. Reproduce from seed rule/procedure for raw-array audit.

continuum_transport.anchor_bound: At anchor a and offset x, pair failure p_a<=u:=min(U_early,U_late), because pair failure is the intersection of the two candidate failure events.
continuum_transport.path_kl: For target r, D(path_r||path_a)=(256-x) D_KL(Q_r||Q_a), because the later-neighbor path contains 256-x post-change Q observations.
continuum_transport.binary_data_processing: For the pair-failure indicator, kl(p_r||p_a)<=D(path_r||path_a). Since p_a<=u, if p_r>=u then kl(p_r||u)<=D(path_r||path_a).
continuum_transport.cover_rule: Anchor a covers target r whenever (256-x)D_KL(Q_r||Q_a)<=kl(0.09||u).
continuum_transport.coverage_result: Adaptive anchors yielded no remaining gap over the full exact I=0.25 variance-ratio interval for every integer offset x=0..64, using double-precision bracketing/root merge tolerance 1e-12. On the simultaneous Clopper-Pearson event, pair failure probability is <=0.09 over the full exact KL level and all discrete offsets, leaving 0.01 absolute slack to beta=0.10.

scope_and_caveats: Exact KL level D_KL(Q||P)=0.25 only; not a theorem for all D_KL>=0.25.
Discrete-time step changes only; within-sample mixture changes are outside scope.
Negative mean shifts are covered by global sign symmetry of the Gaussian MLE/SNML statistic.
Monte Carlo uncertainty is simultaneously controlled as stated, but interval-root/coverage arithmetic is ordinary float64 rather than machine-verified interval arithmetic.

The conditional-SNML simulator uses the exact pathwise MLE/SNML-regret identity and homogeneous-subgroup sufficient statistics; no Gaussian-homogeneity approximation is made for misaligned candidates.
No O, O-derived state, other worker state/config, downstream comparator/integrator/index/feed/audit state, legacy/pre-independence research, shared ledger or other-role receipt semantics were used.
